Hirara has only two skills, representing her two weapons: <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font>. Drag one skill onto the other to cast a combo skill.

Hirara has 2 <font color="a6aafb">Crimson / Death</font> Energy. Casting a combo skill consumes 1 <font color="a6aafb">Crimson / Death</font> Energy. Energy recovery time is the same as the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font>. Consuming Energy interrupts the recovery process.

Hirara only deals 30 (+4*Hero Level)% damage to minions.

Hirara rides the waves using <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font>, performing up to two <font color="a6aafb">joystick dashes</font> (the first dash goes in her facing direction). She deals 150<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit.

Hirara uses <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font> to unleash the <font color="a6aafb">Crimson Maple</font>, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+65% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area.

After a short delay, she deals damage again at the target location, dealing 2 times the initial <font color="a6aafb">Crimson Maple</font> damage.

Hirara has only two skills, representing her two weapons: <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font>. Drag one skill onto the other to cast a combo skill.

Hirara has 2 <font color="a6aafb">Crimson / Death</font> Energy. Casting a combo skill consumes 1 <font color="a6aafb">Crimson / Death</font> Energy. Energy recovery time is the same as the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font>. Consuming Energy interrupts the recovery process.

Hirara only deals 30 (+4*Hero Level)% damage to minions.

Hirara enhances <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font> with the power of <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> to cast a combo skill.
She becomes untargetable and immobilized for up to 1s.
After 0.6s, she deals 3 times <font color="a6aafb">Crimson Maple</font> damage, and can then cast the second <font color="a6aafb">joystick dash</font> of <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> to end these states early.

Hirara enhances <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> with the power of <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font> to cast a combo skill.
After casting the first <font color="a6aafb">joystick dash</font> of <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font>, she spins, dealing 2.5 times the <font color="a6aafb">Crimson Maple</font> damage and immobilizing enemies for 0.8s.

data.name: Hirara
data.story: A geisha ninja from the Scarlet Shadow, armed with dual fans and adorned in crimson maple and the meisen. In her twisted mind, death is the ultimate salvation.

assist.desc: Hirara has high damage output in the early-to-mid game, but the delay in her skills makes landing them less consistent. Hirara works especially well with strong early-game heroes with CC, such as Angela and Minotaur, allowing her to build an early advantage more easily.

strong.desc: Hirara's high mobility allows her to dive the enemy backline with ease, making her an excellent counter to squishy heroes who lack self-protection, like Ixia and Pharsa.The untargetable effect from Hirara's 2nd + 1st Combo Skill is great against delayed skills that deal high damage, giving her a big advantage when facing heroes like Yin and Gusion.

weak.desc: However, while Hirara is quick and nimble, she is also quite fragile. Against burst Assassins with targeted abilities, such as Saber and Natalia, it can be difficult to predict their attacks and use her 2nd + 1st Combo Skill in time. If she gets caught, she'll be taken down instantly.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Marcel's split soul, <font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font>, enters the camera to freeze the moment. His Basic Attacks deal 50<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="62f8fe">(+40% Total Magic Defense)</font><font color="fba51f">(+40% Total Physical Defense)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. His <font color="26e407">Extra <1005></font> is converted into 1.5% <font color="26e407"><1999></font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font> automatically snaps photos of enemy heroes near Marcel, causing a brief <font color="a6aafb">Frozen Moment</font> and dealing 20 (+ 5% of <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> (triggers Attack Effects). It also grants a shield of the same value to Marcel and a nearby allied hero. Cooldown: 12s per target.

<font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font> focuses on an area around Marcel, slowing enemy heroes within by 60%.
After 2.5s, he completes the shot, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="62f8fe">(+120% Total Magic Defense)</font><font color="fba51f">(+120% Total Physical Defense)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies within.

Artist inspiration time! Marcel enters the <font color="a6aafb">Tracking Haste</font> state for 3s, gaining 15% Movement Speed. This bonus increases to 75% when moving toward an enemy hero.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Marcel dashes in the target direction, leaving a framing phantom behind while the <font color="a6aafb">Framed Moment</font> area remains at the original location.

Marcel and <font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font> perform a joint shoot. After a short delay, <font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font> takes a wide-angle shot of the target area for 2s. During this time, Marcel enters the <font color="a6aafb">Tracking Haste</font> state while inside the area. All other units in the area are put into a <font color="a6aafb">Frozen Moment</font> and are immune to all effects except from Marcel. All projectiles are also frozen and will continue after a delay (targeted projectiles will deal 50% damage).

<font color="a6aafb">Golden Hour</font> resets the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Platinum Snap</font> for each enemy hero.
Allied heroes with the <font color="a6aafb">Platinum Snap</font> shield can move freely within the area.

data.name: Marcel
data.story: Hailing from House Paxley, he is an elegant, mysterious, and bizarre artist whose split soul has fused with his camera.

assist.desc: Because of Marcel's excellent AOE CC, he pairs well with allies with high AOE damage, like Hanabi and Ixia, to maximize their damage potential.

strong.desc: Marcel is more effective against low-mobility heroes, such as Layla and Vexana, as they are easily caught by his Ultimate, allowing him and his allies to secure easy kills.

weak.desc: Heroes who possess Invincibility or Untargetable effects that can bypass Marcel's CC, like Ling and X.Borg, will reduce his impact on the battlefield.

data.name: Sora
data.story: A pure and free-spirited boy with unshakeable resolve, drifting across the golden sands.

assist.desc: Sora's transformed Ultimate deals considerable damage, and pairing him with Tigreal, Minotaur, Gatotkaca, and other strong CC heroes will maximize Sora's damage potential.

strong.desc: Sora excels at diving in with explosive burst damage and AOE CC, so squishy heroes without escape abilities—like Layla, Miya, and Hanabi—will find themselves helpless against Sora's relentless assault.

weak.desc: Sora relies on landing his 1st Skill to get Cloudstep stacks. Heroes with high mobility or Knockbacks, like Fanny, Arlott, and Valir, can prevent Sora from gaining this precious resource.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Obsidia gains <font color="a6aafb">Bone Energy</font> whenever she deals damage. Basic Attacks grant 1 Energy against non-hero units and 2 against hero units or Turrets. Skills grant Energy equal to 3 times the amount granted by Basic Attacks against the same unit type. No Energy is gained from hitting creeps.
When <font color="a6aafb">Bone Energy</font> reaches 30, it forms a <font color="a6aafb">Bone Shard</font>, up to 25 shards. When Obsidia uses Basic Attacks, all <font color="a6aafb">Bone Shards</font> strike the target, each dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+6% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and inheriting 6% Attack Effects.
Killing an enemy hero directly grants 1 <font color="a6aafb">Bone Shard(s)</font>.
Obsidia's Basic Attacks deal 70<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, inheriting 100% Attack Effects.

Obsidia launches an <font color="a6aafb">Abyssal Bone Needle</font>, dealing 325<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and triggering <font color="a6aafb">Return to Bone</font> on the first enemy hero struck.
Obsidia descends into the Abyss and enters <font color="a6aafb">Shadowmeld Form</font>, gaining 500% Movement Speed for 0.3s.

Obsidia shoots <font color="a6aafb">Bones of Wrath</font> in the target direction, dealing 125<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and briefly stunning the first enemy hero hit before pulling herself to the target. The <font color="a6aafb">Bones of Wrath</font> tethers Obsidia to the enemy, preventing her from moving more than 4 units away. While tethered, the enemy cannot use mobility skills, and their movement drags Obsidia along. Obsidia also gains 5 temporary <font color="a6aafb">Bone Shards</font> stacks and a shield equal to 200 (+ 25 per <font color="a6aafb">Bone Shard</font> stack). This effect lasts 3s.

While tethered, Obsidia can move through obstacles and use Basic Attacks while moving. <font color="a6aafb">Phantom Shadowmeld</font> is also enhanced: its duration increases to 1s, and its cooldown is reduced to 33%.

data.name: Obsidia
data.story: The ancient Sovereign of the Abyss, risen from ruin, now seeks to slay the God of Darkness and hunt down its Spawns of Decay.

assist.desc: Obsidia usually reaches her damage potential in the mid-to-late game, so she wants support heroes who can help her in the early game, like Angela and Estes.

strong.desc: Obsidia's Ultimate will disable dash and blink skills, making her excellent at countering heroes who rely on them,  such as Hayabusa, Freya, and Lancelot.

weak.desc: Obsidia struggles during the early laning phase, making her vulnerable to other Marksmen with strong early game, such as Bruno and Layla.

skilllist.skilldesc:
<font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Crown</font>: When Zetian hits enemy heroes with <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Strike</font> or <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Descent</font>, she gains 1% Spell Vamp for 5s (up to 10 stacks).

<font color="a6aafb">Celestial Robe</font>: The power of the Phoenix periodically protects Zetian, knocking back and stunning any enemy hero who approaches her, dealing 90 (+10*Hero Level)<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. She also gains a 300 (+20*Hero Level)<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> shield for 3s. Cooldown: 120s.

Zetian unleashes a <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Wave</font> in the target direction. If it hits an enemy, she automatically casts another wave (up to 3 times). Zetian can cast other skills during this time.

The waves deal 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font>, 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font>, and 360<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, respectively. The 3rd wave has a larger area and pulls enemies toward the cast direction (not considered a control effect).

The Spell Vamp ratio against minions is only 65%.

Zetian summons a <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Spirit</font> at the target location, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+45% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and applying a brief 50% slow effect to enemies in the area. The <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Spirit</font> hovers at the location for 3s, dealing 20<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> every 0.5s and reducing enemies' <font color="62f8fe"><1070></font> by 10% while revealing their surrounding area.
While the <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Spirit</font> is active, Zetian can use this skill again to command it to charge toward a designated location, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+45% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and applying a brief 50% slow effect upon arrival.

Zetian calls upon her divine mandate and the hearts of her people, granting all allied heroes 40% Movement Speed that gradually decays over 3s, while bringing divine retribution upon all enemy heroes, dealing 400<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and stunning them for 0.8s. Zetian gains vision of all enemy heroes during this time.
Zetian can cast other skills while channeling this skill.

data.name: Zetian
data.story: Recognized by the Heavens and cherished by her people, the Celestial Empress of the Cadia Riverlands ascends to bring peace to the mortal realm.

assist.desc: While Zetian already has decent survivability, when paired with supports who can protect allies like Floryn and Rafaela, Fighters with limited range will struggle even more to approach Zetian. And with the healing from these supports, Zetian can win any ranged battle of attrition.

strong.desc: Zetian's Passive counters melee heroes with limited gap closers like Balmond and Zilong, allowing her to continue poking the enemy from a safe distance.

weak.desc: Zetian's Ultimate can strike down anywhere on the map, but having such a powerful Ult means a hero like Valentina can also use it against Zetian's team.
